info.name: Neotek All Inbound APIs - Sandbox - Test App
info.description:
Auto-generated from api-gw-apic-consolidated/inbound/apis (all 150 branches, deduped) and the actual OAuth2/apiKey security declarations in each API's OpenAPI 3.0 definition.

Contains 267 requests across 30 folders (one per OAuth2 scope, plus dedicated folders for client-credential-header APIs, no-auth utility APIs, and non-business test endpoints).

CREDENTIALS: {{oauth-client-id}} / {{oauth-client-secret}} (for OAuth2 scope folders) and {{header-client-id}} / {{header-client-secret}} (for client-credential-header APIs) are PLACEHOLDERS. Replace them with your actual sandbox "Test App" credentials before use — these are intentionally different from, and do not reuse, the credentials embedded in "Neotek Vaps Master Collection.postman_collection.json".

Each OAuth2 scope folder has its own "Generate Token" request (matching the pattern used in Neotek Vaps Master Collection). Run it first; it populates the shared {{access-token}} variable used by bearer-auth requests in that folder.

Skipped as duplicate filenames (typo in source repo, missing underscore before version, identical to their correctly-named counterparts): accounts-links1.0.0, financial-institutions1.0.0.

Request bodies/params are populated from the "example" values in each API's OpenAPI spec where present, otherwise minimal type-based placeholders — verify before running against the sandbox.
